title: SENTINEL: A Multi-Pathway Architecture for Detecting Living-Off-the-Land APT Attacks on Windows Command Lines
abstract: arXiv:2609.14593v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Living-Off-the-Land (LOTL) is the dominant evasion technique of Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) actors, exploiting legitimate Windows utilities to conduct malicious operations without deploying custom malware and enabling state-sponsored campaigns to maintain persistent access within military and critical defense infrastructure for extended periods. Existing detection methods fail against obfuscated commands and multi-stage attack sequences, as demonstrated by the Volt Typhoon APT campaign, which maintained undetected access to U.S. critical infrastructure for over 18 months using exclusively signed Windows utilities. We present SENTINEL, a multi-pathway architecture integrating BERT-based semantic encoding, character-level CNN for obfuscation invariance, inter-command attention for multi-stage pattern recognition, and autoencoder-based anomaly scoring. translated_title: SENTINEL：一种用于检测Windows命令行上“就地取材”（LOTL）APT攻击的多通路架构
translated_abstract: “就地取材”（Living-Off-the-Land，LOTL）是高级持续性威胁（APT）攻击者最主要的规避技术，其利用合法的Windows工具执行恶意操作而无需部署定制恶意软件，使国家支持的黑客组织能够在军事和关键国防基础设施中长期保持隐蔽访问。现有检测方法在面对混淆命令和多阶段攻击序列时往往失效，Volt Typhoon（伏特台风）APT攻击活动便是一个典型例证——该攻击活动仅使用经过签名的Windows工具，就在美国关键基础设施中维持了超过18个月未被发现的访问权限。我们提出了SENTINEL，这是一种多通路检测架构，集成了基于BERT的语义编码、面向混淆不变性的字符级CNN、用于多阶段攻击模式识别的命令间注意力机制，以及基于自编码器的异常评分。该系统在基于Microsoft和CISA数据构建的平衡Volt Typhoon基准数据集上进行了评估……
tldr: SENTINEL通过融合BERT语义编码、字符级CNN、命令间注意力机制和自编码器异常评分的多通路架构，有效检测利用合法Windows工具实施规避的LOTL APT高级持续性威胁攻击。
en_tdlr: SENTINEL is a multi-pathway detection architecture integrating BERT-based semantic encoding, character-level CNN, inter-command attention, and autoencoder-based anomaly scoring to effectively detect Living-Off-the-Land (LOTL) APT attacks that exploit legitimate Windows utilities for evasion.
